metadata.short_desc: Parse shared links, videos, galleries and music, with song-search cards, playback and web management.
metadata.desc:
Send a link or a share message in chat to receive a content card and available videos, images or audio.

Supports Bilibili, Douyin, Kuaishou, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Twitter / X, AcFun, NGA, GitHub, Pixiv, Steam, Heybox, QQ Music and NetEase Music.

- Song sharing, numbered search cards, playback and music account management
- Four card layouts, light and dark themes, and adjustable colors, covers and watermarks
- A built-in management page for testing links, browsing records, clearing cache and editing settings
- Webpage screenshots, all-ages Pixiv search, Bilibili QR login and per-platform proxy settings
- Duplicate-link control for groups; media relay or shared storage for Docker deployments

Open Plugin WebUI → Hope Parser and use the Settings page to configure the plugin.
Requires AstrBot 4.25.3 or later. ffmpeg is recommended; without it, Bilibili will try a directly sendable video format.

See the [README](https://github.com/xiaoxi2760/astrbot_plugin_denia_share#readme) for usage and supported content.

denia.description: Overview, manual link parsing, parse-cache management, UI and card appearance customization, and full configuration.
